_audit_note: Every id below was added or split from scripts/audit_league_pairs.py, which lists the league-label pairs the certainty gate refused on the real 5,373-match feed. Two rules governed every decision. (1) A label is only mapped when the feed's own fixtures show what competition it denotes; a bare root word shared by several countries is left unmapped rather than guessed. (2) A competition that is really several groups under one root word gets one id per group, never one id for the family - see nations_league_a..d, spain_primera_federacion_1..5, spain_segunda_federacion_1..5, italy_serie_c_a..c. The pooled labels that publish those groups together ('Liga Nacija', 'Primera Federacion', 'Segunda Federacion', 'Ettan') deliberately keep their own id and do not match any single group.
nwsl: S A D  -  N W S L
_nations_league_note: admiralbet, wwin and mdshop publish 'Liga Nacija' with leagues A, B, C and D pooled into one list, so 'nations_league' is that union and must not be merged with any single league. mbet and mozzartbet publish the leagues separately; each gets its own id. premier_kladionica publishes the sub-groups; the group number carries no separate competition identity here, so a sub-group label resolves to its league.
_spain_pyramid_note: Primera/Segunda/Tercera Federación are each split into groups and two teams can be in different groups of the same tier on the same day, so every group is its own id. wwin's unqualified 'Primera Federacion' and 'Segunda Federacion' pool every group and therefore stay unmapped rather than joining any one group.
_italy_serie_c_note: Serie C is three separate groups; the group letter is part of the competition's identity, so Serie C Group A must never match Serie C Group B.
_argentina_note: Argentina's tiers 2, 3 and 4 are three different competitions (Primera B Nacional, Primera B Metropolitana, Primera C) and must not be merged. Within Primera B Nacional, mbet/mdshop/admiralbet publish both groups as one 'Argentina 2' list while premier_kladionica splits them into grupa a / grupa b - same fixtures, so both group labels resolve to the tier's single id.
_nordic_note: Sweden's Ettan and Norway's 3. Divisjon are each split into a north and a south / group 1 and group 2 division. wwin's unqualified 'Ettan' pools both, so it keeps its own ungrouped id and matches neither.
_latam_note: Klausura / Apertura are the opening and closing phases of one season of one competition, not separate competitions, so each country's phase labels fold into that country's single id.
_womens_note: The women's competitions carry their own ids, never the men's. 'Super Liga (Ž)' and 'Super League (Ž)' are the English Womens Super League as admiralbet and wwin label it, not the Norwegian one; Norwegian women are 'Norveška 1 Ž' / 'Toppserien (Ž)'.
_primera_division_note: 'Primera Division' was listed under la_liga. It is not a Spanish name for La Liga - La Liga is never called that - and on the real feed admiralbet's 'Primera Divizija' is the Uruguayan Primera (progreso, racing montevideo, wanderers, penarol). It now resolves to uruguay_primera, which is what its fixtures are. Measured on the feed this costs no verified group: 252 groups before and after the move.
